title: Teledyne Technologies Incorporated quarterly report for the quarter ended June 28, 2026
excerpt: For Q2 2026 Teledyne reported USD 1,662.5 million net sales, USD 251.7 million attributable net income, USD 5.37 diluted EPS and 20.0% operating margin; first-half operating cash flow was USD 549.2 million and capital expenditure was USD 60.2 million.
summary: The current SEC quarterly filing supplies identity, segment, revenue, margin, earnings, cash-flow, liquidity, debt, acquisition, backlog, share-count, tariff, supply-chain and goodwill evidence for the assessment.
